structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Restricted manufacturing permit; application; fee; separate application and permit for each place of manufacturing
law.text: Every person desiring to manufacture a proprietary medicine or to repackage medical gases shall apply to the Board for a restricted manufacturing permit. The application shall be accompanied by the required fee. Separate applications shall be made and separate permits issued for each separate place of manufacturing.
